title: 💜nostr
desc: Nostr: the decentralized social protocol Bitcoiners are building on. Social media you can't be censored from.

msgs.text: What is nostr? Nostr is a decentralized social media protocol where no one controls the content. Your identity is uncensorable which makes it unique from typical social media platforms. There are many clients that have been built, and the user can choose to use whichever client(s) fit his/her needs. Your "profile" (in which you log in with a string of characters called your nsec - like a password) is integrated into whichever client you use or move to (although there will be slight variations of how things are displayed from client to client. Some features may be missing, etc.). Your public profile can be identified from your npub, and can be made even more identifiable by use of a NIP-05 identifier. More on all of these weird words below. A really cool thing about nostr is that Bitcoin Lightning is fully integrated. Just add a lightning address to your profile and BOOM, people can "zap" you sats for your content.

to address the characterization  <@296365105560551425> made of nostr, I recommend people read the words directly from the horses hoof.
"The simplest open protocol that is able to create a censorship-resistant global "social" network once and for all.

It doesn't rely on any trusted central server, hence it is resilient; it is based on cryptographic keys and signatures, so it is tamperproof; it does not rely on P2P techniques, and therefore it works."

https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nostr
yes the entire point is decentralization
One would imagine he would use the word decentralization in the description if it were the point.
decentralization is what provides the "point" he states in the description

I don't think one can have an open protocol without it being decentralized. Nostr can't work if there's only one client. or if there's only one relay. There can be an unlimited number of clients, and an unlimited number of relays

It seems to have three points, "resilience, tamper-proof. and works"
At least the third point is not decentralization. And the second point is the public-private key cryptography
Needs to be "simple" like nostr is all basically text when it boils down. Same thing with Bitcoin. And the protocol needs to be scalable

Hey, everyone!

Sorry for dropping this in here unexpectedly, but I wanted to share something that a friend of mine, Tanja Bächle, is working on: she's bringing a Nostr Booth to Bitcoin conferences, like what was done earlier this year at BTC Prague: https://youtu.be/60BRF0qurPw. And she's starting with some big ones in Latin America: LaBitConf, SatsConf, and finally, Adopting Bitcoin. 

As I'm sure you know, Nostr, like Bitcoin, is about freedom—this time for speech and social networking through its censorship-resistant, decentralized design—but too few Bitcoiners are aware of it. That’s where the Nostr Booth comes in! **It’s a community-driven initiative to educate people about decentralized, censorship-resistant social media.**

If just **100 people donate $10**, this booth will become a key feature at upcoming bitcoin conferences! Every little bit counts, so please consider helping out, even if it’s just a few sats.
